what: Henri IV to Bellièvre and Sillery at Vervins, 14 March, 9 April and a third letter of April 1598; originals with passages in a figure-letter-sign cipher, about 90 lines in all, no decipherment on the leaves
why_not: The full clear text of these despatches is printed from the Court's copies (BnF Béthune 8972, Brienne 66) in Mémoires et correspondance de Duplessis-Mornay, t. VIII, 1824 (archive.org mmoiresetcorresp08morn; checked: the clear sentences on either side of the f. 241v cipher block are on pp. 173-174 with the enciphered sentences between them; the 9 April letter ends as f. 285r does). Verdict would be 'read' (plaintext in print), not 'open'. Third letter not individually matched.
use: Known-plaintext pairs for the 1598 Court cipher with the Vervins plenipotentiaries (key recovery from external plaintext); not found on Tomokiyo's henryiv.htm (no mention of Vervins or fr. 15911).
